name: Zim Notebook Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Converts pages with the Zim 0.5 and 0.6 headers that current Zim writes.
Plans large notebooks in large vaults without a long freeze.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Pages saved by current Zim, with a format 0.5 or 0.6 header, now convert.
Planning a large notebook in a large vault no longer freezes Obsidian for a long time.
tip: A Zim [x] checkbox marks a dismissed item, so it becomes a - [c] task, not a finished one.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Zim Notebook Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
